text.tspan: Weekly Report
To:Tom Ulaszek
From:Marty Pennock
Subject:Status Report
Date:July 16, 1992
Accomplishments
1.Created GEM files for Sparrow Memory Board Installation Instructions. 7/16/92.
2.Created copies of Sparrow documents and drawings for Jerry Smith. Gave him soft and
hard copy and turned over use of system. 7/16/92.
3.Received Sparrow Hard Disk assembly drawing. 7/16/92.
4.Backed up TT030. 7/16/92.
5.Created GEM file of Sparrow Hard Disk assembly drawing and gave a copy to Jerry Smith .
6.Contacted Mel Stevens and got srtwork done for new ST-Book Power Supply Label.
7.Finished new draft of Sparrow Service Guide and turned a copy in to Tom U. for review.
8.Converted Sparrow Memory PCB silkscreens to GEM format for Jerry Smith. 7/17/92.
9.Started Hard Disk Kit instructions for Sparrow Hard Disk Installation. 7/17/92.
10.Worked on Hard Disk installation instructions and drawings for Sparrow. 7/18-7/21/92.
11.Worked on correcting FALCON030 assembly drawings for Service Guide and Installation
Instructions. 7/22/92.
12.Redrew FALCON030 assembly drawings. 7/22/92.
13.Received new diagnostic source code for Sparrow Service Guide. 7/22/92.
Plans
1.Produce Service Guides for STBook, Portfolio, 2600, Falcon040, and 7800 products.
